title: Low-splash composite-packet graph cellular automaton on the canonical 64-modular seed
novelty_claim: Rebuild cellular-automaton locality around symmetry-safe composite packets and a defect-packet influence graph, so the CA is local in effect rather than only local in raw q/s syntax.
closest_prior_art: Cellular Automata Applications in Shortest Path Problem (2017)
Hybrid cellular automata for topology optimization
differentiation: Uses the published order-668 frontier seed only as a fixed anchor, not as a novelty claim.
Moves on a retained low-splash composite packet library and a sparse defect-packet graph, not the failed single-packet q/s ring used by H1.
Requires matched CA-off and non-CA controls in the same retained basis, so any surviving gain must come from the local CA dynamic rather than from basis engineering alone.
easiest_falsifier: Kill immediately if no retained 2-packet, 4-packet, or run-boundary library both reduces changed-lag footprint sharply and exposes any improving or strategically neutral neighborhood on the canonical seed, or if the graph CA still depends on whole-basis rescoring and loses to CA-off or scorer-only baselines in the same basis.
evidence_plan: Freeze H1 as the negative control and add CA-off mechanism isolation to the same harness.
Enumerate symmetry-safe composite packets and retain only low-splash candidates relative to the one-packet basis.
Build the exact defect-packet influence graph from retained packet delta fingerprints.

Run one matched kill test on the canonical seed and one harder control against CA-off, scorer-only or weighted bit-flip, greedy, tabu, and simulated annealing, with exact-hit rate and changed-lag footprint as the gates.
budget_envelope: One retained composite library, one canonical frontier seed, one harder control, and no broad sweeps until the first kill test survives.
Stop as soon as locality remains fake or basis sharing removes the advantage.

title: Lag-residue cellular automaton on four relaxed 167-channels with hard family-leakage audit
novelty_claim: Promote autocorrelation residues to the primary CA state on the 167-core factor of 668, instead of using lag defects only as scores inside a known structured-family search.
closest_prior_art: Williamson / Turyn / Goethals-Seidel / cocyclic / block-circulant search
differentiation: Represents state directly in lag space on four relaxed 167-channels rather than on raw packets or a fixed classical family.
Keeps one matched non-CA lag-space control in exactly the same coordinates.
Stays viable only if successful states do not collapse back into a known structured family under the leakage audit.
easiest_falsifier: Kill or relabel the branch if useful trajectories still require near-global autocorrelation recomputation, or if promising states canonicalize to Williamson, Turyn, Goethals-Seidel, cocyclic, or block-circulant structure.
evidence_plan: Open this branch only if the composite-packet locality rebuild fails for principled locality reasons rather than simple underperformance.
Instantiate one lag-residue representation and one matched non-CA lag-space control.
Run the saved family-leakage audit before any wider frontier budget is spent.
Keep exact reconstruction or exact-hit improvement as the only acceptance gate.
budget_envelope: One lag-space representation, one matched control, and one mandatory leakage audit.
Hard stop on family collapse, whole-state rescoring, or approximate-only gains.

title: Certificate-coupled decoder-relay cellular automaton for frontier-adjacent repair
novelty_claim: Use a CA only to route exact repair effort into locally stressed defect neighborhoods, with the contribution measured by exact progress per exact call rather than by standalone heuristic movement.
closest_prior_art: The SAT+CAS method for combinatorial search with applications to best matrices (2019)
Decoder-style cellular automata for syndrome repair
differentiation: Frames CA as a proposer or router on sparse defect neighborhoods instead of a direct constructor or global optimizer.
Uses exact filters and certificates as explicit gates after each CA phase rather than treating approximate metric improvement as success.
Only claims novelty if the CA relay improves exact progress per unit exact effort beyond clause-score or scorer-only handoffs.
easiest_falsifier: Kill the branch if the exact layer does the real work, if the CA relay adds nothing beyond ordinary branching or clause scores, or if it only repairs lightly perturbed seeds without moving the canonical frontier case.
evidence_plan: Keep this as reserve until the pure locality rebuild and lag-space backup are decided.
Use one compressed exact subproblem and one frontier-adjacent perturbation ladder, not a broad exact-search program.
Compare CA relay, clause-score handoff, decoder-only weighted bit-flip, and plain exact branching on the same neighborhoods.
Promote only if exact hits per exact call improve under the same certificate gate.
budget_envelope: One compressed exact control plus one frontier-adjacent perturbation ladder.
Stop if hybrid credit belongs to the exact filter rather than to the CA relay.
